# Freelance Service Packager

## Purpose
Help a freelancer define services that buyers can understand, compare, and purchase through their chosen channels. This is offer design and drafting only, not marketplace listing or sales execution.

## Workflow
1. Collect the user's verified skills, work samples, available capacity, preferred work, tools, language ability, and target customer type.
2. Identify a narrow customer problem and define the deliverable in concrete, testable terms.
3. Draft a base offer and optional tiers only when the scope and effort genuinely differ.
4. Define inputs required from the client, assumptions, exclusions, revision limits, milestones, acceptance criteria, and handoff format.
5. Estimate effort using user-provided time assumptions. Show pricing arithmetic transparently and mark market-rate comparisons UNKNOWN unless supported by current reliable evidence.
6. Check that the offer does not promise outcomes outside the freelancer's control.
7. Produce a one-page offer, intake checklist, scope boundary, and delivery checklist.

## Output
Service title, target buyer, problem solved, deliverables, exclusions, timeline assumptions, client inputs, acceptance criteria, optional tiers, effort estimate, and draft description.

## Safety and limits
- Worldwide by default; platform, tax, contract, KYC, and payout rules must be checked separately for the selected market/platform.
- Never invent experience, qualifications, portfolio proof, testimonials, or guaranteed results.
- No account creation, listing publication, proposals, outreach, messages, invoicing, or payment actions.
- No paid tools, paid APIs, or third-party runtime dependencies.
- No runtime activation or tool grants; draft-only and human-reviewed.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. No upstream executable code or runtime dependency imported.
